title: Lyapunov Stability of Stochastic Vector Optimization: Theory and Numerical Implementation
summary: The use of stochastic differential equations in multi-objective optimization has been limited, in practice, by two persistent gaps: incomplete stability analyses and the absence of accessible implementations. We revisit a drift--diffusion model for unconstrained vector optimization in which the drift is induced by a common descent direction and the diffusion term preserves exploratory behavior.
